snapshot.head: 57e8b662ed927416b9d1f1ca45777f0b93c45f9d
snapshot.headSubject: fix(f08): alias landing write is client.query INSERT, not insertLanding

missionPremise: 57e8b66 closed the helper hole: applyAliasLandingRows issues INSERT via client.query. The persist job still lives only on origin/seat/property-ctx-walk-alias-schema. writePersistedAlias prefers insertLanding and runAliasPersist reports wroteLanding from persistCadTxgioAliasBinds array length. A mock write that reports a count without SQL is the defect. Source: ctx-publish src/lib/cad-txgio-alias-persist.mjs writePersistedAlias ~217; src/jobs/alias-persist.mjs ignores the write return; dispatch 2026-08-30_alias-persist-job; OPS-19 F-08.
completionPredicate: This tree has the job. --apply calls applyAliasLandingRows (or the same client.query INSERT). insertLanding is not a write path and is not copied as a fallback. Arm 1: missing landing_cad_txgio_alias refuses ALIAS_TABLE_MISSING with no INSERT. Arm 2: --apply on a test client issues INSERT INTO landing_cad_txgio_alias via query; insertLanding is not called; wroteLanding equals INSERT count. Laptop --apply without FACTORY_ALIAS_PERSIST_GO=1 and a run row still refuses. node --test terminates. No commit, push, deploy, migration apply, job start, or Neon persist.
scopeBasis: This worktree only. ctx-publish / p2-job / gate8 / p2-juris / P:/hauska-factory are read, not written. 0005 / 0005a / 0005b are not applied. No connection URL is printed. Card-H snapshot floors and two-count helpers are ported so the job loads; live card-H read and 0005b apply stay planner-owned.

adversarial.claim: porting writePersistedAlias as-is and adding applyAliasLandingRows as the else branch is enough
adversarial.finding: ctx-publish prefers insertLanding when present. Tests inject insertLanding and never record SQL. That is the mock write. Keeping insertLanding as a fallback copies the defect.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: insertLanding first, query else. Rejected: that is the source hole.

adversarial.claim: persistCadTxgioAliasBinds(apply=true) already sets wroteLanding so the job can report the count
adversarial.finding: that count is landingRows.length before any client.query. runAliasPersist spreads result and ignores writePersistedAlias's return. Mechanism: wroteLanding is assigned in the pure planner, not after INSERT.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: leave the pre-write count and only change writePersistedAlias. Rejected: the job would still report a count without SQL if write is skipped or insertLanding is injected.

adversarial.claim: laptop --apply can be opened for the test client
adversarial.finding: FACTORY_ALIAS_PERSIST_GO=1 and a run row are the freeze. Tests inject those. Laptop env without GO still refuses. Do not weaken.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: skip the GO gate when landingClient is injected. Rejected: that is a laptop --apply hole.

applyPath.what: Port the job onto this tree. writePersistedAlias calls applyAliasLandingRows only. Job --apply uses that wroteLanding. persistCadTxgioAliasBinds does not claim a write. insertLanding is not imported, not called, not copied.
applyPath.sql: INSERT INTO landing_cad_txgio_alias (county_fips, cad_prop_id, txgio_id, situs_key, owners_agree, as_of, method, run_id, valid_to) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,true,$5::timestamptz,$6,$7::uuid,NULL)
applyPath.triggers: factory alias-persist --apply after FACTORY_ALIAS_PERSIST_GO=1 and a run row
applyPath.fails: ALIAS_TABLE_MISSING when information_schema has no landing_cad_txgio_alias; ALIAS_PERSIST_GO_REQUIRED / RUN_ROW_REQUIRED on laptop --apply; ALIAS_LANDING_WRITE_REFUSED when client.query is absent
applyPath.bypasses: a raw INSERT on the bake store; applying 0005 as drafted (forbidden); the unwritten ctx-publish branch still prefers insertLanding until that tree is retired

bothArmsPlanned.arm1_missingTable: runAliasPersist --apply with GO + run row + a query client whose information_schema returns empty. Rejects ALIAS_TABLE_MISSING. Issued SQL is the exists SELECT only. insertLanding not called.
bothArmsPlanned.arm2_realInsert: same gate plus table present. INSERT INTO landing_cad_txgio_alias via query. insertLanding not called even when injected. wroteLanding equals INSERT count.

constraintsHonored: no commit, push, deploy, job start, bake, publish
no 0005 / 0005a / 0005b apply to any live store
ctx-publish / p2-job / gate8 / p2-juris / P:/hauska-factory not written
